worldcombat.skill.voltswitch.summary: Stick an arc on the aimed target or point, then ride the current to blink to a safe spot; the stay style keeps fighting on the field, while the switch style trades places with a waiting reserve. Repositioning instead of retreating, and the only ranged special of the three folds.
worldcombat.skill.voltswitch.use.0: Poke from range, then blink to a new position
worldcombat.skill.voltswitch.use.1: Discharge and leave before being broken
worldcombat.skill.voltswitch.use.2: Bring a tougher reserve in with the switch
worldcombat.skill.voltswitch.description: The arc strikes a non-allied living target for about %1$s special damage.
Range %1$s blocks, the arc flies at %2$s blocks per tick with a %3$s block hit radius.
Blinks %1$s blocks and offsets %2$s blocks to the side; with a partner within %3$s blocks it lands behind them.
worldcombat.skill.voltswitch.relay.on: Stay style: after the blink it keeps fighting on the field; arc power x0.85, cooldown +6 ticks, blink x0.85.
worldcombat.skill.voltswitch.relay.off: Switch style: arc power x1.2, blink x1.2 further; with a legal reserve it swaps straight to it after the blink.
worldcombat.skill.voltswitch.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recover %3$s s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.voltswitch.growth.0: From level %1$s the arc rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.voltswitch.growth.1: From level %1$s the arc rises to %2$s.
On (stay): after the blink it keeps fighting on the field, but arc power x0.85, cooldown +6 ticks, blink x0.85. Off (switch): arc power x1.2, blink x1.2 further, and with a legal reserve it swaps straight to one after the blink.
Beyond this distance it closes in first; a ranged move, so raising it blinks from further out and lowering it pokes only up close.
Below this health ratio, volt switch is ranked first to discharge away; raise it to leave earlier, lower it to keep it for emergencies.
When on, the user blinks away even under a hold order; off refuses the move under a hold order, since it always leaves the spot.
worldcombat.skill.voltswitch.description: The blink happens whether or not the arc hits, including firing at open ground, being stopped by a wall, or expiring, and only once per cast; the landing is checked step by step from the current feet along the blink distance against real support and the native free-space probe, lands behind an ally when one is in range with a sideways offset, and stays put when no safe spot is found.
